regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-directional rotation (eligible 14/16) with Precious Metals leading: Gold Miners rank 1 (score 2.167, durability 0.85, trend, breadth 1.0, not crowded), followed by Silver & Royalties and Base Metals & Copper (crowded). This is an attention/focus lens only; momentum rank-IC has been weak and my own track record shows direction accuracy of only 0.302, so directional leans must be treated as low-conviction hypotheses, not forecasts.
emerging_watch: Watch whether 'Silver & Royalties' (score 1.615, rank 2, durability 0.77) closes the margin vs Gold Miners (currently 0.552) and flips rank-1 with improving durability — I would retire this watch if the margin between them widens back beyond 0.8 for five consecutive sessions, suggesting Gold reasserts clear leadership.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the only theme combining top rank with a trend-tag, full breadth, high durability (0.85), and no crowding. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg, and this theme sits above an elevated durability bar — a reasonable condition for staying power of the trend, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Gold leadership reflects defensive/geopolitical positioning, which can unwind quickly if risk appetite returns; the high score is coincident attention, not forward alpha, and my own direction accuracy is only 0.302.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its 20-day average before the 21-day check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals sits rank 3 with full breadth and a mid-high durability bar, suggesting a broad trend in the theme. The crowding flag (crowded true, z 1.23) is a size-down caution only, never a fade — the lean is a direction with humility, not a sizing call.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.23 means the theme is extended and any growth shock could hit it harder at the margin; a momentum lens with weak rank-IC gives no forward edge, and cycle-sensitive copper often leads downside first.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO lags XGD.TO by more than 4% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities rank 11 with score -0.557, mean-revert tag, very low breadth (0.083), and a low durability bar (0.37). Even without intent to recommend shorting, a low-conviction underweight relative to the stronger trend and breadth of the precious metals complex is a reasonable directional lean.
theses.dissent: Utilities are a crowded-defensive counterweight that can outperform in exactly the geopolitical/risk-off tape that dominates the current macro narrative (unscheduled surprises 0.89 share); the detector momentum rank has no predictive edge, so this could be a value trap avoidance miss.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO outperforms XGD.TO by more than 3% over a rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
